purpose: Evaluate whether conditioning empirical integer score-pair support in native predicted home-score/away-score coordinates improves a market-blind NFL score distribution without using sportsbook prices, key-number targets, outer-fold outcomes, or post-cutoff information for candidate construction.

architecture.mean_structure: Fit two deterministic ridge regressions on the existing market-blind M2 feature vector: one for realized home_score and one for realized away_score. Do not fit margin or total as response variables in V2F.
architecture.support: Observed integer home_score/away_score pairs from outer-training rows only.
architecture.support_coordinate_rule: For a support game in season S, predicted home_score and away_score coordinates must be generated by models fit only on seasons strictly before S. A support point is forbidden if its coordinate model includes season S or any later season.
architecture.target_coordinate_rule: The held-out target game's predicted home_score and away_score may use the full outer-training set, never the outer-test season.
architecture.kernel: Two-dimensional Gaussian kernel in predicted home_score/away_score coordinate space.
architecture.bandwidth_source: Training-only residual standard deviations from the corresponding home-score and away-score ridge models.
architecture.distribution_output: Normalize weighted observed integer score pairs exactly to probability mass 1.0, then derive moneyline/spread/total probabilities from that same joint distribution.
architecture.calibration: Use the existing frozen NFL historical calibration procedure unchanged.
architecture.market_pricing: Use the existing V2 game-market pricing semantics unchanged. Market fields may be used only after the joint score distribution exists, for evaluation/pricing, never as model inputs or support-weight inputs.

motivation_frozen_without_holdout_tuning: The empirical support object is natively a pair of team scores. V2F tests a coordinate system aligned to that native object rather than margin/total coordinates. This is a structural modeling hypothesis and not a parameter response to any previously observed holdout miss magnitude, signed key-number error, calibration bin, sportsbook line, or candidate-specific outer-fold result.
attempt_budget_rule: V2F is a materially distinct model specification. Any evaluation on a sealed candidate-selection holdout consumes one attempt under the frozen NFL feature-search policy unless the applicable policy explicitly classifies that evaluation outside the attempt budget. No holdout run may occur until the repo records the applicable attempt accounting.
decision_rule: One frozen V2F specification only. If it fails any required predictive, calibration, integrity, or key-number gate, reject V2F. Do not tune alpha, kernel scales, feature set, coordinate rule, training window, calibration thresholds, or gate thresholds in response to the holdout result. Any revision must receive a new candidate ID and a new preregistration before evaluation.
